title: StarkweatherOFC-CCEP: orbitofrontal cortico-cortical evoked potential recordings, 7 patients (Starkweather et al.) (derivative)
description: Preprocessed intracranial recordings of cortico-cortical evoked potentials (CCEPs) elicited by single-pulse electrical stimulation of orbitofrontal cortex in seven patients. The derivative dataset provides unreferenced and bipolar-referenced per-electrode timeseries at 1000 Hz, with stimulation times and amplitudes as events. It supports study of effective connectivity and homotopic communication between human orbitofrontal subregions.
methods_description: Authors' preprocessed per-electrode orbitofrontal timeseries (unreferenced and bipolar, 1000 Hz) were repackaged as BrainVision float32 in microvolts. Single-pulse stimulation times and amplitudes were written to events.tsv. Original release files were retained in sourcedata.
